text: Name a European Cup or Champions League finalist

facts.Real Madrid: Won the first five European Cups in a row, from 1956 to 1960, and has won more than anyone since.
facts.Barcelona: Their first European Cup came at Wembley in 1992, from a Ronald Koeman free kick against Sampdoria.
facts.Liverpool: In 2005 they came back from 3–0 down at half-time to beat AC Milan on penalties in Istanbul.
facts.Bayern Munich: Won three European Cups in a row, from 1974 to 1976.
facts.Manchester United: Scored twice in stoppage time to beat Bayern Munich in the 1999 final.
facts.AC Milan: Seven European titles: only Real Madrid have won more.
facts.Juventus: Have lost more European Cup and Champions League finals than any other club: seven.
facts.Chelsea: Won their first Champions League in 2012, on penalties against Bayern in Bayern’s own stadium.
facts.Stade de Reims: Lost the very first European Cup final, 4–3 to Real Madrid in Paris in 1956.
facts.Partizan Belgrade: Lost the 1966 final 2–1 to Real Madrid in Brussels.
facts.Malmö FF: The only Swedish club to reach a European Cup final, losing 1–0 to Nottingham Forest in 1979.
facts.Panathinaikos: Reached the 1971 final at Wembley with Ferenc Puskás as their manager.
